total_funding_usd.quote: Eventual recently raised two rounds of funding within eight months. The first was a $7.5 million seed round led by CRV. More recently, the company raised a $20 million Series A round led by Felicis with participation from Microsoft's M12 and Citi.

last_round.quote: the company raised a $20 million Series A round led by Felicis with participation from Microsoft's M12 and Citi

note: Eventual (daft.ai) is a YC W22 company confirming the task hint — same company, not a coincidence of name. Its open-source engine Daft is a Python/SQL multimodal dataframe library run on customer infrastructure (laptop, Kubernetes, or Ray); it is not an AI-agent sandbox/VM provider. Eventual is building a separate early-access, contact-only commercial robotics data platform (scenario mining / training-set curation over robot fleet video) with no public pricing. Funding: seed ($7.5M, CRV) and Series A ($20M, Felicis, with M12 and Citi) both closed within an eight-month window reported June 2025; an earlier undisclosed YC/angel round (Caffeinated Capital, Array.vc, YC) also occurred.
